title: Kagamine Rin — A Dreamy Mountain Of Grapes〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: As the Leaves Change Once More

rows.Line: School SEKAI
se_walk_women_002_4

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright, everyone, the wait is over!
It's in this classroom!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, can you tell us what's inside?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You'll know when you go inside... Probably...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Probably?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, we did our best, but it still ended up looking like a bit of a hodgepodge...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho, shh!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Anyway, it's now officially... Open♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, there's something set up in the middle.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Aren't those coatracks?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But it appears to be wrapped in some sort of vine with leaves on it...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And the things hanging from it... Are those grapes?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I know! This is supposed to look like that vineyard we visited!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Correct! We have a winner♪
Congratulations, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Remember how we said we're gonna have a grape party when we were over there? We gave it a lot of thought after that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Having you guys eat the grapes we harvested was one idea, but we felt that it'd be more fun if you also had a chance to pick your own.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Exactly♪
It's way more fun when you do it yourself!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Sakki, Shih...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Still, getting coatracks to look like a vineyard was pretty hard.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We did what we could using the ones we had at our houses. We even borrowed a bunch of props from Tsukasa and his troupe...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha... They had a lot of amazing plant props, but none of them were grapes.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No, don't worry about how it looks!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I also kinda wished that I could pick grapes with you guys while we were at that vineyard!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
So, I'm really happy!
Thanks for doing this for us, Sakki, Shih!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then, why don't we get started?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're really supposed to cut these stems, but you'll all have to make do with picking individual grapes. Is that okay?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, you even prepared bowls for all of us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We have plenty of napkins here, so feel free to use as many as you like!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The grapes closest to the top of the stem are the sweetest, so I recommend starting from the bottom and working your way up!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I see. But before we start eating...
We have our choice of red and white grapes. Which should we have first?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I'm gonna have some red ones♪
And the one at the very bottom is... Oh, this one!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Alright, there we go...!
Sakki, Shih, I've got some now!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: These grapes are much bigger than I thought. I'm not sure I can eat any of these in one bite...

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Hmm?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You two seem to have your cheeks fully stuffed. How many did you both eat just now...?

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Two!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Wait, you both had two at once?
I think I'll join you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, these white ones are so sweet.
I thought they'd be more tart.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
That may vary based on the type.
Conversely, these red grapes are sweet but have a refreshing aftertaste.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, the grapes towards the top really are much sweeter compared to the ones at the bottom...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
See?!
I think I'll have one of those now♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You certainly seem to be enjoying yourself, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I am! Sakki and the others were all smiling from ear to ear that day.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
And now...
My heart's overflowing with happiness and excitement!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Do you think Sakki and Shih felt the same way that day?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I'm sure...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I knew it...!
